# A required feature without a value fails the report with exit status 1.
# The report is still written and still validates.
unhex $ROUNDTRIP/sm121a-roundtrip.cubin.hex k.cubin
! cudainspect report -symbol addk -require opcode_histogram $WORK/k.cubin
stdout '"result": "failed"'
stderr 'required feature unavailable: opcode_histogram$'
cp stdout report.json
readreport report.json

# The same feature as optional only makes the report partial.
cudainspect report -symbol addk -optional opcode_histogram $WORK/k.cubin
stdout '"result": "partial"'
! stderr .

# A feature the inspector does not implement is unsupported, not dropped.
! cudainspect report -symbol addk -require spill_bytes $WORK/k.cubin
stdout '"name": "spill_bytes",\s+"state": "unsupported"'
stdout 'feature not implemented'

# Dynamic shared memory needs a launch configuration.
! cudainspect report -symbol addk -require dynamic_shared_bytes $WORK/k.cubin
stdout 'requires launch configuration'
